name: xtium-sharepoint
description: Read-only SharePoint/OneDrive MCP on your device via customer Entra public-client sign-in. Tokens and file content stay local.
long_description:
Local stdio MCP connector for Claude Desktop (AIDATA-3958 pilot).

- Signs in as **you** with the customer's Entra **public** desktop app (no client secret).
- Calls Microsoft Graph directly from this machine. XTIUM never sees tokens or document bytes.
- Configure **Tenant ID** and **Client ID** at install time; then run `sharepoint_sign_in` in chat.

Requires a customer (or lab) app registration: single-tenant, public client, redirect `http://localhost`, delegated `User.Read`, `Sites.Read.All`, `Files.Read.All` (+ OIDC).
